posts.author: The Decoder
posts.text: Anthropic's Q3 revenue hits $16.8B but growth slows ahead of planned November IPO. Anthropic hit $16.8 billion in third-quarter revenue, a 45 percent gain that still falls far short of Q2's 140 percent surge. With a November IPO approaching, some investors now expect the company's valuation to drop below $1.5 trillion. Slowing growth and a tough market are cooling expectations for the AI boom's biggest Wall Street test yet. posts.text: Nvidia's Jensen Huang pledges $2 billion for Europe, $250 million in compute for UK safety labs. Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang announced $2 billion in European investments and new stakes in French startups like Doctolib and Entalpic. The UK gets $250 million in compute for AI agent safety and security research. Huang pitched open-weight models as Europe's way to close the AI gap.
